tasks.name: Set up project structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with the necessary folder structure and dependencies.

tasks.name: Create frontend layout
tasks.description: Design a single-page layout with a text input area and a save button.

tasks.name: Implement text entry functionality
tasks.description: Allow users to type text into the input area.

tasks.name: Set up backend API
tasks.description: Create a backend API to handle saving notes.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Integrate the frontend save button with the backend API to save notes.

tasks.name: Implement database for notes
tasks.description: Set up a database to store the notes entered by users.

tasks.name: Integrate database with backend
tasks.description: Connect the backend API to the database for saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Test text entry functionality
tasks.description: Ensure that users can type text into the input area without issues.

tasks.name: Test save notes functionality
tasks.description: Verify that notes are saved correctly to the database via the backend API.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a hosting environment for users to access.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a folder structure with separate directories for frontend, backend, and database; initialize version control and package managers.
T1.notes: Ensure the structure supports scalability and modularity.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a basic UI layout using HTML, CSS, and a frontend framework like React or Vue.
T2.notes: Focus on a clean and user-friendly interface.

T3.implementation_approach: Add a text input field with event listeners to capture user input.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a RESTful API using a backend framework like Express or Django.
T4.notes: Define endpoints for saving and retrieving notes.

T5.implementation_approach: Use HTTP requests (e.g., Axios or Fetch) to connect the frontend to the backend API.
T5.notes: Handle errors and loading states appropriately.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database like MongoDB or PostgreSQL to store notes with appropriate schemas.
T6.notes: Ensure data integrity and indexing for performance.

T7.implementation_approach: Integrate the database with the backend by connecting it and implementing CRUD operations.

T8.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests to verify the text entry functionality works as expected.
T8.notes: Use a testing framework like Jest or Mocha.

T9.implementation_approach: Test the save notes functionality by simulating API calls and verifying database updates.
T9.notes: Include edge cases and error handling in tests.

T10.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Vercel, Netlify, or AWS.
T10.notes: Ensure environment variables and configurations are set correctly.
